## Plane Crash Example

<https://www.planecrashinfo.com/2025/2025.htm>

## ```{r tidy_tc_crashes}
year = 2025

crash_url = paste0('https://www.planecrashinfo.com/', year, '/', year, '.htm')

crash_page <- rvest::read_html(crash_url, encoding = "ISO-8859-1")

# What we learned last class is that if I were to read this as an HTML table, I have no control onw hat goes into each column in teh resulting data frame -- this makes cleaning it (extracting text from it) more challenging

crash_page |>
  rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(1) > font > a") |>
  rvest::html_text2() -> dates

crash_page |>
  rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(2) > font") |>
  rvest::html_text2() -> loc_op

# Skipped column 3 exactly similar for time purposes
crash_page |>
  rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(4) > font") |>
  rvest::html_text2() -> fatalities

df = data.frame(dates = dates, location = loc_op[-1], fatalities = fatalities[-1]) |>
  tidyr::separate(
    loc_op, into = c("location", "operator", sep = "\n")
  )
```
